title: African Economic Outlook 2024: Driving Africa’s Transformation: The Reform of the Global Financial Architecture
summary: The African Development Bank's 2024 flagship report calls for reform of the global financial architecture to drive Africa's structural transformation, including a greater voice for Africa in multilateral development banks and international financial institutions. Gideon Ndubuisi contributed to the report.
keyFindings: The report estimates Africa's financing gap for structural transformation at US$402.2 billion a year to 2030.
It argues that domestic resources alone will not be enough to finance Africa's transformation agenda.
